Hello people

These days I have no idea whats best to use. I want something clean and minimalistic, that actually does the job of protecting your computer. Does software like this exist? I don't trust norton and mcaffee and they seem very intrusive and full of crap in general.

I use Qihoo personally. I normally wouldn't use a Chinese antivirus package, simply because of worries about governmental interference, but it actually seems to be quite good, and uses not just Qihoo's own engine but Bitdefender's and Avira's too.

Failing that, I'd say Avira for free antivirus and Kaspersky for paid.

I did use Avast, but they are incredibly invasive. I hate that. I used AVG for a while, but they have the absolute worst foistware.

Ugh.

Still searching.

For my enterprise clients we recommend Sophos but their home offerings are limited at best. Mac and Android both have a free version of Sophos which is the full AV but missing some of the enterprise features (web content filtering etc...). You can also run their full router software on your own PC which gives you 12 free enterprise grade AV's. it's worth it if you are tech savvy but it's designed for computer techs and not your average home user.

Besides that the best lightweight and full protection product out there is Eset. Don't bother with the free stuff because you normally get what you pay for.

I don't know if this is a good metric of "best" but it's interesting and related nonetheless. This is the list of how well each AV works against the Hacking Team software (or vice versa): https://libertasintel.wordpress.com/2015/07/08/how-good-is-your-antivirus-against-hacking-team-code/
